![](images/4a/4a7e89a828cbd660357d4834e0bcb9cb5c316dbe24419865206ba5f41872963d.png)

The power of a mobile phone emitter increases when the phone is switched on. The power output of the emitter after $t$ minutes is given by $W(t),$ where $W$ is measured in watts. The graph of $W(t)$ is shown above. 
Approximate the rate of increase in the power of the emitter when $t=1$ using a forward difference approximation with step size $h=2.$

![](images/5f/5f13b035369b4e90ec258b6558a764b5ba75e2e04d4748bb7197552fea2eff71.png)

Some water is heated to $100^{∘}C$ and is then allowed to cool. The temperature of the water after $t$ hours is given by $T(t)$, measured in degrees Celcius. The graph of $T(t)$ is shown above.
Approximate the rate of change in the water's temperature after $t = 2$ hours using a forward difference approximation with step size $h = 1$.

![](images/20/204afb23fc438b047c72d6233b59b70c4741ee16a30a57c084682a3d14fd2188.png)

A thin soap film is stretching over time. The graph of its surface area $A(t)$, in square centimeters, after $t$ minutes is shown above. Approximate the rate of change of the surface area at $t=2$ using a forward difference with step size $h=2.$ Do not round the answer.

After $2$ minutes, the surface area increases at a rate of {{field-1}} ${\text{cm}}^{2}/\text{min}.$

![](images/d8/d84ba0a07821011be4cf5958af44ea73e97493c5a796a0324b068fe2adca8a12.png)

A car is using petrol as it travels. The graph of the amount of petrol $P(d)$, in liters, remaining in the fuel tank after traveling a distance of $d$ miles is shown above. Approximate the rate of change of the amount of petrol at $d=150$ using a forward difference with step size $h=50.$ Do not round the answer.

*Hint*: Assume that the rate of change is negative if the amount of petrol decreases.

After traveling $150$ miles, the rate of change of the amount of petrol is {{field-1}} liters per mile.

![](images/84/846fc347c71ada4c01a5a85aabd0722203b84edbafcbe462064ae31d1cf2adbb.png)

A drone is descending toward the ground. The graph of its height $H(t)$, in meters, after $t$ minutes is shown above. Approximate the rate of change of the height at $t=9$ using a forward difference with step size $h=2.$ Do not round the answer.

*Hint*: Assume that the rate of change is negative if the height decreases.

After $9$ minutes, the rate of change of the height is {{field-1}} meters per minute.

![](images/ae/ae57faa04abd053e4a58d751cc084d58e07e84e0520c99a33a122f58dfd8f18c.png)

A slice of jackfruit is placed in an air dryer. The graph of the moisture content $M(t)$, in percent, after $t$ hours is shown above. Approximate the rate of change of the moisture content at $t=3$ using a forward difference with step size $h=2.$ Do not round the answer.

*Hint*: Assume that the rate of change is negative if the content decreases.

After $3$ hour, the rate of change of moisture content is {{field-1}} percent per hour.
